comment: Accepted gaps of the syscall trace conformance matrix. Each entry names a syscall, a gap kind (no_decoder: the recorder has no decoder for a pointer argument and records an explicit NO_DECODER field; not_captured: the program passed data the recorder does not capture; render: the Syscall Trace view cannot name a value) and why it is accepted. 'unexercised' lists slots no fixture case reaches, with the reason. A gap or an unexercised slot missing here fails the suite.

undescribed.reason: The recorder copies user memory without faulting (it runs in the syscall entry path). A page the program has mapped but not yet touched in this process is recorded as NOT_RESIDENT (contract revision 8, section 15.1), and the call itself is unaffected. It happens to static glibc reading /proc/self/exe before main, and to forked children: fork() copies no page-table entries for file-backed private mappings, so a child's first use of a literal string or of a stack/rodata page is not resident. The oracle fixture prefaults its image; torture children do not. A later capture at exit, after the kernel itself faulted the page in, would close this; it needs a contract change and is proposed separately.
